Site visit and assessment

Full audit · On-site
Choose audit type, then assess each article in a full-screen workspace. Saved findings appear below as a brief summary — scoring and outcomes are on the next step.
Themed audit — add articles to assess:
Audit outcomes already sent. Editing findings after letters have been issued requires admin permission.
Click Assess on an article to open the full-screen workspace. Choose failure type, describe what you saw, then set RAG. Optionally link a related failure from another category.
Awaiting information. Process paused until Duty Holder responds. Article 27 formal request available if they do not cooperate (14-day deadline).

Scoring and enforcement decision

Review assessment scoring rolled up from the site visit. Attribute failings to Duty Holders and confirm one outcome per Duty Holder — the audit has no single outcome.
No findings recorded yet. Return to the site visit stage to assess articles.

Outcomes and letters

Record the EMM dialogue, confirm or adjust each Duty Holder's outcome, then generate and send the appropriate letters — one per outcome per Duty Holder. System letters are produced as editable Word documents (.docx).

Action plans

Enforcement notices and 28-day action plans are tracked as separate threads per Duty Holder. Each thread is monitored independently until closed.

Assignment

Administrator assigns the lead inspector. The assigned inspector begins at document review once assignment is complete.

Review documents (15-day SLA)

Assigned inspector reviews architect plans, fire strategy and consultation form. SLA reminders trigger as the deadline approaches. Use Log in the activity bar for interim activity and time.

Insufficient information letter sent. The 15-day SLA is paused until building control responds. Log interim activity and set reminders as needed.
